marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US cloud hyperscalers reported increased Q2 capital expenditure plans targeted at AI server infrastructure, while semiconductor suppliers saw mixed performance amid updated export policy reviews.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending secures strong revenue visibility for upstream hardware vendors, though short-term margin compression remains a concern for cloud providers until AI software monetization accelerates.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of enterprise AI spending growth and potential tighter controls on cross-border technology transfers.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech & Digital Platforms
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rallied as major Chinese internet platform operators announced expanded share buyback initiatives and reported stabilized ad revenue growth.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced shareholder return programs combined with disciplined cost management continue to rebuild investor confidence and support valuation multiples across HK-listed platform giants.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Intensity of domestic price wars in local services and logistics, as well as the overall pace of Chinese retail consumption recovery.

marketLayer.title: Chinese New Energy Vehicles (NEVs)
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed Chinese EV makers posted solid mid-month delivery numbers, supported by aggressive promotional campaigns and new model rollouts.
marketLayer.inference: Industry consolidation is favoring top-tier EV OEMs with superior supply-chain integration, driving volume growth at the expense of weaker entrants.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving foreign trade barrier policies, including European Union tariff implementations, and domestic margin compression.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Policy & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: Recent US inflation and labor market data signaled a gradual economic cooling, maintaining market expectations for Fed policy easing in the second half of the year and keeping US Treasury yields range-bound.
marketLayer.inference: A stabilizing interest rate backdrop reduces macro headwinds for growth equities and helps lower overall borrowing costs, potentially encouraging fund flows back into Asian emerging markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of unexpected inflation reigniting due to supply chain disruptions or sticky service sector costs.
